summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Americas Gold and Silver Corporation, a foreign private issuer, providing an operational update. The filing announces the completion of Phase 2 of the No. 3 Shaft upgrades at the Galena Complex, which increases hoisting capacity by 100%, and reports on two minor incidents: an electrical fire at the Galena Mine and a wildfire near the Crescent Mine, both of which caused short-term disruptions but no significant damage or production guidance impact. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate event triggering a special-situations classification is present. The filing is a routine current report on operational progress and safety incidents.
